variants.headline: Still in view: union calls a strike
variants.sub: A strike has been called by a union in the colony.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A union has called a strike in {colony}.

We support {target} in this assessment. A call for collective action deserves a fair account, and the existence of conflict does not establish that every accusation against a participant is justified.
